summary: Updated implementation plan for SmartStock ERP reflecting the latest user requirements: disbanding Staff, Suppliers, and Master Inventory panels into contextual inline operational flows; strictly hiding Audit Logs from non-admins with immutable revert history; multi-admin consensus approval workflow for system reset; admin-only Reorder Level governance via Product Specifications modal; full-screen username/PIN login with logout action; collapsible sidebar; and silent backend formula execution in Ghanaian Cedis (GH₵).
